item.title: Young Real Salt Lake players score in 3-2 victory over Atlanta United
item.description: Rookies Sergi Solans and teenager Aiden Hezarkhani scored four minutes apart in the first half and Real Salt Lake went on to spoil Atlanta United's home opener with a 3-2 victory Saturday night.

item.title: Cooley scores in overtime to lift Utah Mammoth past Columbus Blue Jackets, 5-4
item.description: Logan Cooley scored his second goal of the game at 2:08 of overtime Saturday night as the Utah Mammoth beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-4 for their third straight victory.

item.title: Weber State hockey team seeks donations ahead of Nationals
item.description: The Weber State club hockey team has a 38-2 record and a shot at a national championship. Now, they are rallying community support to help fund their trip to compete in St. Louis.
